body:
New tools/gbtool/gltf.go (stdlib-only GLB/glTF reader), gskel.go/gmesh.go (Go writers for previously Go-less .gskel/.gmesh formats), import_gltf.go (real quaternion channel convention <joint>.qx/qy/qz/qw). Live-verified through the real C runtime loaders, not just the Go writer. Commit GOLDENBAND ac45152.

⚓ ☃
title: gbtool: real glTF import (quaternion animations, mesh, skeleton)
